summary: The ML platform landscape in 2026 has consolidated around a handful of cloud-native and multi-cloud contenders, with the global MLOps market reaching $4.39B and projected to hit $89.91B by 2034. Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, and Databricks Mosaic AI lead enterprise adoption, with Google's offering now folded into the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and open-source tools like MLflow and Kubeflow remaining strong for DevOps-capable teams. You need a full ML platform when managing reproducibility, governance, large-scale training pipelines, or multi-model deployments at scale — teams with simpler needs or pure inference workloads can often rely on model APIs alone without the operational overhead.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go compute; Studio UI free; enterprise tier with reserved instances and managed endpoints
platforms.best_for: Microsoft-heavy enterprises needing mature MLOps, governance, and deep Azure ecosystem integration

platforms.name: Amazon SageMaker AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use compute; SageMaker Studio free; inference endpoints priced by instance hour; Savings Plans available
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams needing breadth of ML tooling, infrastructure control, and tight integration with AWS data services

platforms.name: Databricks (Mosaic AI + MLflow)
capabilities: Unified data and ML platform (lakehouse architecture)
MLflow 3.x experiment tracking and model registry
Mosaic AI for LLM fine-tuning and RAG pipelines
platforms.pricing: DBU (Databricks Unit) consumption-based pricing; varies by cloud, workload type, and tier (Standard, Premium, Enterprise)
platforms.best_for: Data-centric organizations needing unified analytics, ML, and AI governance across clouds with a lakehouse foundation

platforms.name: Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI)
capabilities: Managed generative AI and agent workflows
Vertex AI Model Garden (foundation model access)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go compute and prediction pricing; token-based pricing for Gemini APIs; committed use discounts available
platforms.best_for: GCP-native teams and organizations focused on generative AI, large-scale data workloads, and managed agent pipelines

platforms.name: Dataiku
capabilities: End-to-end ML and AI project management
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription (annual license); pricing based on users and compute; free Community Edition available
platforms.best_for: Cross-functional enterprise teams needing collaborative, governed AI projects with both technical and business user access

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription; usage-based tiers; free trial available
platforms.best_for: Enterprises prioritizing automated model building, AI governance, explainability, and regulated industry compliance

platforms.name: Domino Data Lab
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription; hybrid deployment options; custom pricing based on compute and users
platforms.best_for: Regulated industries (pharma, finance, insurance) needing reproducibility, audit trails, and strong governance on hybrid infrastructure

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source H2O-3 free; Driverless AI and enterprise H2O AI Cloud subscription-based; custom enterprise pricing
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and data scientists needing powerful AutoML, open-source flexibility, and strong explainability for business-critical models

platforms.name: Weights & Biases (W&B)
capabilities: Integration with all major training frameworks
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; Team plan ~$50/user/month; Enterprise plan custom pricing; self-hosted available
platforms.best_for: ML research teams and enterprises needing best-in-class experiment tracking, model comparison, and LLM evaluation across any training infrastructure

platforms.name: MLflow (open-source + managed)
capabilities: Integration with SageMaker, Azure ML, Databricks
platforms.pricing: Open-source and free; managed via Databricks (DBU pricing); Azure ML and SageMaker managed integrations included in platform pricing
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting open-source, framework-agnostic experiment tracking and model management with no vendor lock-in

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Open-source and free; infrastructure costs only; commercial distributions via Canonical, Red Hat, and Arrikto
platforms.best_for: DevOps-capable teams needing portable, Kubernetes-native ML pipelines with full infrastructure control and no SaaS lock-in

platforms.name: Modal
capabilities: Serverless GPU compute for training and inference
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second GPU and CPU usage; no idle costs; free tier with $30/month credit; transparent per-GPU-second rates
platforms.best_for: ML engineers and startups needing fast, serverless GPU infrastructure for training and deployment without managing Kubernetes or cloud VMs

notable_opus_additions: Google Vertex AI (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform)
